name: Verify successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: App is installed and launched. User is on Login screen.
expectedResult: User is successfully authenticated and Home screen is displayed.

name: Verify deep link email verification flow
preconditions: App is installed. User has pending verification.
steps: Trigger custom scheme deep link aavis://verify?link=test
Verify app opens and navigates to Verify screen
expectedResult: App intercepts deep link and displays verification flow.

name: Verify camera permission prompt on first scan
preconditions: App installed, camera permission not yet granted.
steps: Verify native Android permission dialog appears
Verify app displays fallback manual entry/upload UI
expectedResult: App handles denied camera permission gracefully.

name: Verify barcode scanning with live camera
steps: Inject test image stream to camera (Appium mock) or verify camera view active
Verify transition to AI Analysis Result screen
expectedResult: App correctly scans barcode and retrieves product details.

name: Verify offline banner and persistence
preconditions: User is logged in on Dashboard.
steps: Disable device WiFi and Cellular via Appium
Verify cached history items are visible
expectedResult: App gracefully handles offline state and restores connection.

name: Verify session persistence after backgrounding
steps: Send app to background for 10 seconds
Verify user remains logged in on the current screen
expectedResult: App maintains state and session after backgrounding.
